questions.prompt_html: \sqrt [ 5 ] { 1040 } \text { 的近似值，可适用近似公式} ( 1 + x ) ^ { \alpha } = 1 + \alpha x , \text {这时式中的} x = [ \quad ] .
\text{用微分代替增益得} \ln ( 1 . 005 ) \approx [ \quad ] .

questions.prompt_html: \text{设} |x| \text{与正数} a \text{比较要小的多时,用微分法可得} \sqrt[n]{a^{n}+x} \text{的近似公式} \left[ \quad \right].

questions.analysis_html: \sqrt[n]{a^{n}+x}=\sqrt[n]{a^{n}(1+\frac{x}{a^{n}})}=a(1+\frac{x}{a^{n}})^{\frac{1}{n}}\approx a(1+\frac{x}{na^{n}})=a+\frac{x}{na^{n-1}}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设} \left| x \right| \text{近似于零且} \alpha \text{是大于} 1 \text{的常数，用微分法可得} \\& e^{a-x} \text{的近似公式 } [ \quad ]. \end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{array}{l} { r } { e ^ { a } ( 1 - | x | ) } \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text{解答} \\ x \rightarrow 0, e^{x} \approx 1 + x, \text{所以} e^{a + x} = e^{a} \cdot e^{x} \approx e^{a} (1 + x) \, . \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \ f ( x ) = \sqrt [ 3 ] { 1 + x } \text {在点} x _ { 0 } = 6 . 5 \text {近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& f(x) = \sqrt[3]{1+x}, f^{\prime}(x) = \frac{1}{3\sqrt[3]{(1+x)^{2}}}\\& f(6.5) = \sqrt[3]{1+6.5} = f(7-0.5) \approx f(7) + f^{\prime}(7) \cdot (-0.5) \\& = 2 + \frac{1}{12} \times (-0.5) = \frac{47}{24}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \cos 60 ^ { \circ } 30 ^ { \prime } \text { 的近似值为 } [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&f(x)=\cos x,\ f'(x)=-\sin x,f'(\frac{\pi}{3})=-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \text{所以}\\&\cos 60^{\circ}30^{\prime}=\cos(\frac{\pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{360})\approx f(\frac{\pi}{3})+f'(\frac{\pi}{3})\cdot(\frac{\pi}{360})\\&=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\times \frac{\pi}{360}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text{函数}f(x)=\sqrt{1+x}+\frac{2}{1-x}-3.1 \text{在}x=0 \text{的线性化可表示为} \\ [ \quad ]. \end{array}

options.label: C
options.html: - \frac { 5 } { 2 } x - \frac { 1 } { 5 }

options.label: D
options.html: - \frac { 5 } { 2 } x - \frac { 1 } { 10 }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\\&\text{由}f'(x)=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{1+x}}+\frac{2}{(1-x)^2},\text{得}f'(0)=\frac{5}{2},\text{又}f(0)=-0.1, \text{于是}\\&f(x)=\sqrt{1+x}+\frac{2}{1-x}-3.1\quad\text{在}\quad x=0\quad\text{的线性化}\\&L(x)=f(0)+f'(0)(x-0)=\frac{5}{2}x-\frac{1}{10}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{正方形的边} x = 2 . 4 m \pm 0 . 05 m , \text{则正方形面积的相对误差为[ } \quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答 正方形的面积} A = x ^ { 2 } , \text {于是面积的相对误差为} \\ \delta _ { A } = \left| \frac { \Delta A } { A } \right| \approx \left| \frac { 2 x \Delta x } { x ^ { 2 } } \right| = \left| \frac { 2 \Delta x } { x } \right| = 2 \cdot \frac { 0 . 05 } { 2 . 4 } = 4 . 2 \% , \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \sqrt[3]{998.5} \text{的近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\sqrt[3]{998.5}=\sqrt[3]{1000-1.5}=\sqrt[3]{1000(1-\frac{1.5}{1000})}\\&=10\sqrt[3]{1-0.0015}\approx 10(1-\frac{1}{3}\times 0.0015)=9.995\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \sqrt [ 100 ] { 1 . 002 } \text { 的近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& f(x) = \sqrt[100]{x},\ f'(x) = \frac{1}{100}x^{-\frac{99}{100}}, f'(1) = \frac{1}{100}, \text{所以}\\& \sqrt[100]{1.002} = f(1.002) = f(1+0.002) \approx f(1) + f'(1) \cdot 0.002 \\& = 1 + \frac{1}{100} \times 0.002 = 1.00002\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \tan 136^{\circ} \text{的近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答} \\&\tan x \approx \tan x_0 + (\tan x)^{\prime}\Big|_{x \rightarrow x_0} \cdot (x-x_0),\,\,\, 136^{\circ} = 135^{\circ} + 1^{\circ} = \frac{3\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{180}, \text{所以} \\&\tan 136^{\circ} \approx \tan \frac{3\pi}{4} + \sec^2 (\frac{3\pi}{4}) \cdot \frac{\pi}{180} \approx -0.96509\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {按近似公式} f(x_{0}+\Delta x) \approx f(x_{0})+f^{\prime}(x_{0})\Delta x, (\text {当}|\Delta x|\text {很小时}), \\ \sqrt{99} \approx [ \quad ] \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& f(x)=\sqrt{1+x}, f'(x)=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{1+x}}\\& \sqrt{99}=\sqrt{100-1}=10\sqrt{1\cdot \frac{1}{100}}\approx 10\left[f(0)+f'(0)\cdot(-\frac{1}{100})\right]\\& =\frac{199}{20}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \cos 29 ^ { \circ } \text {的近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&f(x)=\cos x,\ f'(x)=-\sin x, f'(30^\circ)=-\frac{1}{2}, \text{所以}\\&\cos 29^\circ =f(29^\circ)=f(30^\circ-1^\circ)\approx f(\frac{\pi}{6})+f'(\frac{\pi}{6})\cdot(-\frac{\pi}{180})\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\times(-\frac{\pi}{180})\approx 0.87476\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{计算球体体积时，要求精确度在} 1 \% \text{以内，测量半径} R \text{的相对误差不能超过}\left[\quad\right].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{解答} \\ & \text{由} V' = \frac{4}{3} \pi R^3, \; dV = 4 \pi R^2 \Delta R \; , \; \text{可得} \\ & \left| \frac{dV}{V} \right| = \left| \frac{4 \pi R^2 \Delta R}{\frac{4}{3} \pi R^3} \right| = 3 \left| \frac{\Delta R}{R} \right| \leq 1\%, \; , \\ & \left| \frac{\Delta R}{R} \right| \leq \frac{1}{3}\% = 0.33\% \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{半径为}10\text{厘米的金属圆片加热后，半径伸长了}0.005\text{厘米，面积增大了}[ ]\text{平方厘米}.
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\\&A=\pi r^{2},r=10cm,\Delta r=0.005cm, \text{所以}\\&\Delta A\approx dA=2\pi r\Delta r=2\pi \times 10 \times 0.005=\pi (cm^{2})\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \arcsin 0.5002 \text{ 的近似值为} [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\\&f(x)=\arcsin x,f'(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\\&f(0.5002)=f(0.5+0.0002)\approx f(0.5)+f'(0.5)\cdot 0.0002\\&=\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-0.5^{2}}}\times 0.0002=0.52383\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{用微分代替增量得} \sqrt[4]{80}\ [\quad].
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答} \\ \text {由函数的线性化公式可得在}x=0\text {附近有公式} \\ \sqrt[3]{1+x}\approx 1+\frac{1}{n}x\quad,\quad\text {可得} \\ \sqrt[3]{80}=\sqrt[3]{81-1}=\sqrt[3]{3^{4}-1}=3\sqrt[3]{1-\frac{1}{3^{4}}}\approx 3(1-\frac{1}{4\cdot 3^{4}})\approx 2.9907\,, \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{当} x \approx 0 \text{时,} \ \tan x \approx [ \ \ ] , \tan 1 ^ { 0 } \approx [ \ \ ]
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\\&\text{当 }x \approx 0\text{ 时，由公式 }\Delta y \approx dy = f'(x)dx\text{，所以}\\&\tan x \approx \tan 0 + \sec^20 x = x\ ;\ \tan 1^{\circ} \approx 1^{\circ} = \frac{\pi}{180} = 0.0174\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{当} x \approx 0 \text{时,} \ \ln ( 1 + x ) \approx [ \quad ] , \ln 1 . 002 \approx [ \quad ]

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}\text{计算球体体积时，要求精确度在 }2 \% \text{以内，测量直径 } D \text{ 的相对误差不能超过} \ \quad ] .\end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\\&\text{由}V=\frac{1}{6}\pi D^{3},\;dV=\frac{\pi}{2}D^{2}\Delta D\;,\; \text{可得}\\&\left|\frac{dV}{D}\right|=\frac{\left|\frac{\pi}{2}D^{2}\Delta D\right|}{\left|\frac{1}{6}\pi D^{3}\right|}=3\left|\frac{\Delta D}{D}\right|\leq 2\%,\\&\left|\frac{\Delta D}{D}\right|\leq \frac{2}{3}\%=0.667\%\end{aligned}
